message:
4 Wedding Registry Rules Guests Will Thank You For

1. Register before you send save-the-dates.
2. Add about two gifts per guest across low, medium and higher prices.
3. Mix in a cash, honeymoon or charity fund.
4. Never print the registry on the invitation. Put the link on your wedding website instead.

Read the full guide: https://bridalteam.com/guides/wedding-registry-guide?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=2026-10&utm_content=2026-10-30-noon-wedding-registry-rules
